result.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
result.summary: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 looped 架构推理时 KV-cache 随递归次数线性增长的问题：先用 stochastic depth 预训练诱导收缩式残差动态，使各次递归的表示趋向共同极限；再提出 BeNice! 后训练，将末次递归的 KV-cache 广播至首次递归，在保持困惑度的同时实现跨深度 KV 共享。
AI.relevance_reason: 「跨递归表示收敛到共同极限」这一发现可供核查 loop 式推理中相邻迭代的 latent 状态是否高度冗余，与跨深度相似度、缓存结构和动态计算停止的判断相关；但该工作为纯文本效率研究，未涉及视觉或多模态证据。
